description: Source code for the IPEndPoint class handling IP address and port serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversions within the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP endpoint with address and port, providing serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversion functionalities.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Creates an IPEndPoint object from a base::Value dictionary containing 'address' and 'port'.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the IPEndPoint to a base::Value dictionary.

methods.name: GetForAllInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an IPEndPoint bound to all interfaces (0.0.0.0) with specified port.

methods.name: GetFamily
methods.description: Returns the address family of the IP address.

methods.name: GetSockAddrFamily
methods.description: Returns the socket address family (AF_INET, AF_INET6, etc.) based on IP address size.

methods.name: ToSockAddr
methods.description: Fills a sockaddr structure with the IP address and port.

methods.name: FromSockAddr
methods.description: Initializes IPEndPoint from a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the IP address with port.

methods.name: ToStringWithoutPort
methods.description: Returns string representation of the IP address without port.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator for ordering IPEndPoints, IPv4 before IPv6.
